subject.title: [Feature]: Support Excel (.xlsx/.xls) and generic binary uploads in gateway / input_file

question: Should `/v1/responses` `input_file` grow a durable binary workspace receipt contract for allowlisted Excel/generic files, or should binary/document work stay limited to existing chat.send media paths and narrower document/provider-native issues?
rationale: The remaining work changes a public Gateway API and security boundary, so automation should not choose persistence, redaction, URL fetch, and tool-access policy on its own.

options.title: Define binary input_file receipts
options.body: Add a bounded Gateway contract for allowlisted binary files with sanitized storage, metadata, explicit errors, and docs before implementing Excel defaults.

options.title: Split to narrower tracks
options.body: Keep this issue as a product umbrella and route provider-native forwarding, read-tool document parsing, and channel extraction to their separate canonical issues.

options.title: Do not expand input_file
options.body: Keep `/v1/responses` limited to text/PDF extraction and ask users to use existing chat.send/media workspace paths for binary artifacts.

recommendation.title: Define binary input_file receipts
recommendation.body: Add a bounded Gateway contract for allowlisted binary files with sanitized storage, metadata, explicit errors, and docs before implementing Excel defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: He is tied to the input-file limit-resolution and Gateway/OpenResponses history and was explicitly mentioned in the issue discussion.
